hero.kicker: Ship with the fastest growing Caribbean shipping firm in NYC!
hero.title: Make Ship Happen!
hero.lede: For all your freight shipping services to St. Lucia and all islands of the Caribbean. Barrels, boxes, packages, cars, containers & all personal effects.

faq.q: How long does shipping to St. Lucia take?
faq.a: Most sailings arrive in 10–14 days, plus 1–2 days for customs clearance at the port. Check the schedule above for exact cut-off and arrival dates.

faq.q: What can I pack in a barrel?
faq.a: Non-perishable food, clothing, household goods, toiletries, small electronics. No aerosols, flammables, or restricted items — call us if you're unsure and we'll tell you straight.

faq.q: Do you pick up from my home?
faq.a: Yes — anywhere in the five boroughs. Add home pickup when you get your quote or call (718) 483-8006 to schedule.
Vieux-Fort and Cul-de-Sac in St. Lucia, plus connections to other Caribbean islands through our West-Indies Shipping partners — call us for rates beyond St. Lucia.
Cash, card, or Zelle at drop-off or pickup — or lock in your quote online with a card deposit. Your estimate is confirmed when we weigh and manifest your cargo.
